'''Travis Meadows''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[2001 Texas State Championship]] on 31 March 2001 with [[Quiet Mining Colony / Independent Operation|QMC/Sabacc/Weather Vane start]], according to Justin Warren's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2007">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-04-02-2001-texas-state-championshipsd2007/ 2001-texas-state-championships], DeckTech (Justin "hoostino" Warren, 2 April 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-04-02-2001-texas-state-championshipsd2007/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
